summary: Iteration 101: Tested Approval Workflow with targetCompanyId requirement and Tutor Dashboard analytics. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend verified: Dashboard Tutor tab present with data-testid, summary cards (Total de Perguntas: 10, Cursos com Perguntas: 4, Empresas Ativas: 2), company breakdown section, search input, and refresh button. StoryboardPanel has all required data-testid attributes for company selector dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend POST /api/agent/sessions/{id}/submit-for-approval correctly requires targetCompanyId and returns 400 if missing
Backend GET /api/agent/approval-queue correctly filters by targetCompanyId for aprovador role
Backend GET /api/admin/tutor-dashboard returns aggregated tutor question data with company breakdown
Backend GET /api/admin/tutor-dashboard/course/{project_id} returns detailed course analytics
Frontend Admin.jsx has 'Dashboard Tutor' tab with data-testid='tab-tutor-dashboard'
Frontend TutorDashboard.jsx shows summary cards, company breakdown (super admin), and courses list with top questions
Frontend StoryboardPanel.jsx has company selector dialog with data-testid='approval-company-dialog', 'approval-company-select', 'confirm-submit-approval'
Companies list is fetched and passed to StoryboardPanel for super admin users
seed_data_creation: 8 sample tutor_logs entries exist in DB for dashboard testing (3 courses: Seguranca Digital, Compliance LGPD, Lideranca Eficaz)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Approval workflow with company selector and Tutor Dashboard fully functional. Backend endpoints: POST /api/agent/sessions/{id}/submit-for-approval (requires targetCompanyId), GET /api/agent/approval-queue (filters by targetCompanyId for aprovador), GET /api/admin/tutor-dashboard, GET /api/admin/tutor-dashboard/course/{id}. Frontend: Dashboard Tutor tab in Admin page shows analytics with 10 questions across 4 courses and 2 companies.
